item.description: Splay 0.3 - An equaliser for each app and each output, with presets (Electronic, Hip-hop, Podcast & speech, Laptop speakers and more). Each app now has mute, EQ and menu buttons. - Record apps, browser tabs, system sounds and your microphone to M4A or WAV. - Fixes clicks when Splay plays an app through the Mac's own speakers. - Optional anonymous usage count, off unless you switch it on in Settings › Privacy.
